# James

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

James emphasizes practical Christian living, teaching that authentic faith produces visible obedience, wisdom, humility, and perseverance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">James 1:22</div>

<div class="identifier">Be ye doers of the word</div>

### Why This Verse

Core message of James

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches perseverance through trials and the importance of obedient faith. The key verse emphasizes being doers of God's Word rather than merely hearers.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">James 2:17</div>

<div class="identifier">Faith without works is dead</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most discussed NT verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter condemns favoritism and explains the relationship between faith and works. The key verse teaches that genuine faith demonstrates itself through action.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">James 3:17</div>

<div class="identifier">The wisdom that is from above</div>

### Why This Verse

Godly wisdom

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses the power of the tongue and the nature of true wisdom. The key verse highlights the need for self-control in speech and wisdom from above.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">James 4:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Submit yourselves therefore to God</div>

### Why This Verse

Spiritual warfare and humility

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns against worldliness, pride, and self-reliance. The key verse calls believers to submit themselves humbly to God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">James 5:16</div>

<div class="identifier">The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous prayer verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses wealth, patience, prayer, and restoration. The key verse emphasizes the effectiveness of fervent, righteous prayer.
:::
